source: Conservative inlet quadrature, positive mass/enthalpy/momentum and boundary-work ledgers. No interior attractors or timed fractures.
references: Farrell dry experimental melt; Violay glass-free basalt creep reference. Mixed constitutive references, not calibrated free-surface basalt.
